top_strength: Joanna gathered all four discovery basics early (name, date, destination, approx. size) and when Rachel raised a genuine concern about packer care, Joanna went two layers deep with detailed training and vetting info plus damage coverage reassurance, then stayed engaged when Rachel asked follow-up questions about crew roles.
coaching_note: This call should have opened with the quid pro quo time-box and explicit walkthrough routing in Section 1 ('this will take 10–15 minutes, and for a move this size we'll set up a virtual walkthrough to give you a dependable quote — does that sound good?'), not jumped straight into pricing; Their Agenda was also never asked, missing the chance to understand Rachel's stated priorities before the walkthrough.
booking_note: Customer did not commit to specific dates but agreed to schedule a virtual walkthrough: 'just let us know once you already have a better idea in terms of the dates, then we can set up your virtual walkthrough'
